# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose has long hair and an untrimmed beard, giving him an odd, side-show appearance to outsiders. He deliberately refrains from shaving his face or trimming his hair.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)_

## Personality

Ambrose is an exceptionally resolute and obstinate individual with a quick temper. He takes things lightheartedly, never treating anything seriously, and often laughs off matters that upset others. He is fiercely committed to his political principles, refusing to compromise on oaths he makes.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## Traits

- Resolute
- Quick-tempered  <sub>[v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)</sub>
- Fiercely committed Grit  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>
- Humorous and lighthearted

## Abilities

- Cod-fishing  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## History

During a fiercely contested general election campaign fifteen years prior, Ambrose swore publicly that he would refrain from shaving his face or trimming his hair until his political party, the Grits, returned to power. Because the Liberals failed to achieve victory, he maintained his promise into middle age, growing out his hair and beard and earning a reputation for looking like an oddity. Throughout his life, he remained acquainted with Captain Saul, with whom he went cod-fishing. Eventually, he became engaged to Miss Winifred, agreeing to let her wear a wedding veil if she wished, and married her about four weeks after their arrangement.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c37 P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017)_
